annotation.title_clean: Lineamientos recomendados para el uso de herramientas de inteligencia artificial por parte de los órganos de la Administración del Estado
annotation.title_en: Recommended guidelines for the use of artificial intelligence tools by State Administration bodies
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio Secretaría General de la Presidencia; Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología, Conocimiento e Innovación (Chile)
named_instruments_referenced: Ley 19.628 sobre protección de la vida privada
Decreto 7 de 2023 (Norma Técnica de Seguridad de la Información y Ciberseguridad)
annotation.summary_en: Chilean government circular recommending guidelines to State Administration bodies on using AI tools: human-centred AI, non-discrimination, citizen participation, transparency about AI use, personal data protection and cybersecurity compliance, staff training, and follow-up by the Data Directorate. A first step toward a common framework.
key_provisions_or_claims: Assess whether AI is the most appropriate solution before adopting it
Ensure no arbitrary discrimination from AI use
Inform citizens of AI tools used, including chatbots, in clear language
Comply with Law 19.628 and do not enter personal data into non-contracted generative AI
Train public officials; DGD monitors implementation via digital transformation coordinators
